content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment initially for 89 days, extendable up to a maximum of 03 years subject to satisfactory performance, conduct report from HOD and written request Total Senior Resident tenure three years including earlier SR service, or till joining of Regular SR or Permanent Doctor, whichever is earlier Service governed by the residency scheme of Govt. of India/Civil Services (Temporary rules) Contract can be terminated at any time by the Medical Superintendent without assigning any reason Resignation requires a prior notice of 7 days Selected candidates must join within 07 working days of the offer letter; no extension
